lines: Pharaoh saw the path, and followed them into the sea, with all his soldiers.
And when the last of the Children of Israel had crossed... the sea closed over Pharaoh and his army.
As the water overtook him, the man who had called himself a god cried out:
"I believe that there is no deity except the One in whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of the Muslims."
But it was too late. "Now? And you had disobeyed before, and were of the corrupters."
"So today We will save you in body, that you may be a sign to those who come after you."
The tyrant who killed the babies of Bani Israel was drowned... in the same water that once carried baby Musa to safety.
